rationale:
Issue #244 ('Wrong registration order when environment specified') reports that a dependent with no environment (AppServiceUser) is registered before its dependency (Service annotated with an environment), breaking initialization; renaming the class changed the order, confirming the sort failed to see the dependency edge. The production fix is a single condition added to the predicate in lookupDependencyWithNoEnvOrHasAny: with the buggy code, when the dependent's envs list is empty and the candidate dep declares environments, neither d.environments.isEmpty nor d.environments.any((e) => envs.contains(e)) holds, so the dependency is not found and sortDependencies emits the dependent first. Adding 'envs.isEmpty ||' restores the edge, which is exactly the reported symptom's mechanism. The minimized production patch is identical to production-fix.patch and contains only that one line; the CHANGELOG entry, pubspec version/constraint and pubspec.lock changes, and the stray blank lines in injectable/example/bin/main.dart present in original-commit.patch are all excluded from the minimized patch. The trigger 'should sort as [A,B]' is the unchanged upstream test from the same fixing commit and exercises sortDependencies with DependencyConfig.factory('Service', envs: ['dev']) as the dependency of an env-less dependent, mirroring the issue scenario at the generator level; both sortDependencies and DependencyConfig.factory are pre-existing APIs also used by the adjacent pre-existing sort test, so the trigger introduces no dependency on new production API. Strict evidence for both the original and post-minimization runs passes all gates, including trigger.buggy_differential and trigger.fixed_clean with 3 repetitions across a 32-run matrix, and full_suite.buggy_reproduces_only_triggers with the single declared selector. active_same_project_root_causes is empty and milad-akarie/injectable#244 is the verified allowed key, so this root cause is not a duplicate.

Issue #244 ('Wrong registration order when environment specified') reports that a dependent with no environment (AppServiceUser) is registered before the environment-scoped dependency it consumes (Service annotated with an env), so ordering falls back to name order and initialization fails. The production fix is a single condition added to the dependency-lookup predicate in lookupDependencyWithNoEnvOrHasAny: `envs.isEmpty ||`, which makes the lookup succeed when the consuming side carries no environment set, so sortDependencies can place the env-scoped dependency first. That is exactly the reported failure mode, not a behavior extension. The minimized production patch contains only that one hunk in injectable_generator/lib/code_builder/builder_utils.dart; the CHANGELOG entry, pubspec version/constraint bumps, pubspec.lock path switch, and the stray blank lines in injectable/example/bin/main.dart present in the original commit are excluded. The trigger 'should sort as [A,B]' is the unchanged upstream test from the same fixing commit and uses only pre-existing APIs (DependencyConfig.factory, sortDependencies, both already exercised by neighboring tests in the same file); the fix introduces no new production API. It encodes the issue's shape directly: a consumer with no envs depending on a type registered with envs ['dev'], asserting the dependency sorts first. Strict machine evidence reports all gates passed on both the original and post-minimization runs: build.both_versions, selectors.present_and_unique (1/1), trigger.buggy_differential reproducing test/code_builder/builder_utils_test.dart::should sort as [A,B], trigger.fixed_clean, trigger.deterministic (3 fingerprint groups), full_suite.buggy_reproduces_only_triggers, full_suite.fixed_all_green, matrix.complete (32 runs, 3 repetitions). No failed checks. active_same_project_root_causes is empty, so this root cause is not a duplicate, and milad-akarie/injectable#244 is the supplied verified issue key.
